name: comp-142

frames.best_why: The box is ticked and the revealed field holds typed text, showing the expansion fully working.

tagline: Tick the box and a text field slides open beneath the description.
summary: A labelled checkbox with a short description that, when ticked, unrolls a full-width text field and puts the cursor in it. Unticking folds the field away and disables it.
appearance: A small square checkbox sits left of a bold label and a grey description line on a near-black stage. Once ticked, the box fills light and a rounded outlined text field opens below the description, spanning the row.
behaviour: Ticking grows the hidden field open with a smooth height change and moves focus straight into it; unticking collapses it and greys it out. The label and description stay in place above.
demo_content: Label "Checkbox with expansion", a description line about labels, and the "Enter details" placeholder.
search_phrases: checkbox that reveals a text field
check to enable a form field
tick box opening a description field
use_when: Ticking a box should branch into one more detail, such as a reason or a date, without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Only one field is revealed, its copy is fixed, and the input carries a hardcoded id.
customise: Nothing is a prop: label, description and placeholder are literals and the field's id is hardcoded, so reuse means editing the file.
weight_why: A checkbox, a small text block and a grid-row height transition.

a11y.note: Checkbox, description and the revealed field are all labelled, but the height transition ignores reduced-motion.

polish_why: Tidy progressive disclosure with auto-focus; the demo copy is plain but the interaction is clean.
title: Checkbox With Expansion
